question: Who is the first Indian to create a record by winning two gold medals in Para-Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** is the first Indian to create a record by winning two gold medals in the Para-Olympic Games.
 
• He won his first gold medal in javelin throw at the **2004 Athens Paralympics**.
 
• Jhajharia clinched his second gold medal in the same event at the **2016 Rio Paralympics**, setting a new world record.
 
• His achievements have made him a prominent figure in Indian sports, especially in the field of para-athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** was born on **10th June 1981** in Rajasthan, India.
 
• He lost his left hand after accidentally touching a live electric cable at the age of eight.
 
• Despite his disability, he pursued sports and became a successful javelin thrower.
 
• Jhajharia has been honored with several awards, including the **Padma Shri** and the **Arjuna Award**.
 
• He continues to inspire many aspiring athletes with his determination and achievements.
